description: Resource Type definition for AWS::LicenseManagerLinuxSubscriptions::SubscriptionProvider. Registers a third-party Linux subscription provider so that License Manager can retrieve subscription details for the discovered Linux instances in an account.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length.

SubscriptionProviderArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Linux subscription provider resource that you registered.

SubscriptionProviderSource.description: The Linux subscription provider that the registration is for.

SecretArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Secrets Manager secret that contains the access token for the third-party Linux subscription provider.

SubscriptionProviderStatus.description: The status of the third-party subscription provider access token from the last subscription data request.

SubscriptionProviderStatusMessage.description: A message that describes the status of the third-party subscription provider access token.

LastSuccessfulDataRetrievalTime.description: The timestamp from the last time that License Manager retrieved subscription details from the registered third-party Linux subscription provider.

Tags.description: The metadata tags assigned to the registered subscription provider.
